Nadia Park: Hey everyone! I'm Nadia Park — joining as a backend infra engineer. Based in Seoul (UTC+9). I collect vinyl, go birdwatching on weekends, and fold origami when I hit bugs. Desk is on 2nd floor near the succulents. Happy to meet folks for coffee or ramen recs :wave:
Samir Goyal: Welcome, Nadia! Vinyl collector = instant friends. We have a small record club and a rotating listening party. Ping #music if you want to join. Coffee pots are by the 3B fridge :coffee:
Becca: Welcome!! :tada: When's your first day onsite? Rooftop lunch is usually Friday — we save a seat for new folks :)
Devex Bot: Badge access: Nadia Park added to 2nd-floor access group. Badge pickup available at reception between 9–5.
Raj: Awesome to have you here. If you like birdwatching, join the weekend hike group. Also curious — what's your favorite record? I'm big on Coltrane.
Maya: Welcome!! Also fyi the kitchen rotates kombucha on Wed/Thu and @Samir and I usually do ramen runs on Thursdays if you want to join. :ramen:
Nadia Park: Thanks so much! I'm starting remote next Monday and plan to come in the week after for badge pickup. Favorite record is Miles Davis — Kind of Blue. I'll bring a copy for the listening party :grin:
Becca: Kind of Blue is perfect. Rooftop seat = reserved.
Samir Goyal: I'll DM you about the music channel and ramen run. There's usually a quick new-hires coffee at 4pm in #watercooler if you want to drop by.
Maya: Yay welcome aboard :heart_eyes:
Devex Bot: Welcome thread pinned to #new-hires for 7 days.
